subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB562 — THE TWO EXCEPTIONS ARE THE RULE'S OWN CONTENT, AND BOTH ARE RIGHT IN FORMAT 1. (i) "initialization is not affected by a JUSTIFIED clause" -- probe gr7just: `05 J PIC X(5) JUSTIFIED RIGHT VALUE "AB"` and `05 K PIC X(5) VALUE "AB"` BOTH give [AB   ], so the JUSTIFIED item is byte-identical to its unjustified twin; the national form `05 NJ PIC N(4) JUSTIFIED RIGHT VALUE N"AB"` gives NJ=[AB  ] (probe gr7noedit). (ii) "no editing takes place" -- probe gr7noedit: `05 AE PIC XXBXX VALUE "ABCDE"` gives AE=[ABCDE], while the CONTROL `MOVE SRC TO A2` into the identical PIC XXBXX gives A2=[AB CD] -- the two paths are measurably different, which is the point (a probe that only showed [ABCDE] could pass because the emitter ignores edit masks everywhere). (iii) the 14.6.8 DELEGATION -- MEASURED for the categories the compiler builds: fixed-point numeric right-aligns with zero fill (`05 N PIC 9(5) VALUE 12` -> N=[00012]); a scaled numeric aligns on the decimal point (`05 M PIC 9(3)V99 VALUE 1.5` -> [   1.50] through PIC ---9.99); SIGN LEADING SEPARATE holds the sign (`05 SS PIC S9(3) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE VALUE -12` -> [ -12] through PIC ---9); category boolean zero-fills to the RIGHT per 14.6.8.6 (`05 BL PIC 1(4) USAGE BIT VALUE B"10"` -> BL=[1000], and `IF BL = B"1000"` is true) -- probes gr7just, gr7more2. NATIONAL LEG, MEASURED (kb/Work PB876, wave 1020 A): the vehicle exists - a national-edited PICTURE was un-staged by PB492 (COBOL0899 no longer fires) - and `01 NE PIC NNBNN USAGE NATIONAL VALUE N"ABCDE"` displays ABCDE (no editing: 13.18.63.4 GR7) where the MOVE control `MOVE N"ABCDE" TO NE2` into the identical picture displays AB CD (golden 2002/pb876_national_value_no_editing_bwz_inert). The JUSTIFIED half has no national-EDITED population by construction: 13.18.32.3 SR3 admits JUSTIFIED only for alphabetic, alphanumeric, boolean and national items, so a national-edited item with JUSTIFIED is COBOL2405 - the national JUSTIFIED leg is the plain national item, byte-measured earlier (NJ PIC N(4) JUSTIFIED RIGHT). Verdict PARTIAL -> CONFORMS.
